Bhayangkara vs Bali United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the Indonesian Liga 1, where Bhayangkara FC hosts Bali United. This is a meeting of teams showing different results this season: the home side has found good form and is climbing the table, while the visitors are experiencing problems, especially in defense.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Patriot Candrabhaga Stadium, Bekasi Competition: Indonesia Super League

Bhayangkara vs Bali United: Match Preview

Bhayangkara comes into this match on the rise, having secured four wins and two draws in their last seven league matches. This has allowed the team to move up to the middle of the league table. Bali United, on the other hand, has shown inconsistent results, alternating between wins, draws, and losses. The team's main problem is their defense, having conceded 16 goals in nine matches. Despite this, the head-to-head history favors Bali United, who have won four of the last six encounters, while Bhayangkara has been stronger only once.

Team Form and Analysis

Bhayangkara

'The Guardians' rely on a cautious style of play and a solid defense, having conceded only six goals in the league. At the same time, the team's goal-scoring record is modest, with only nine goals scored. In recent home matches, Bhayangkara has played confidently, securing two wins. The team often uses wing attacks, which leads to a high number of corners - an average of 5.9 per game.

Bali United

The 'Tridatu Warriors' are experiencing clear issues with game balance. The team scores a fair amount (14 goals), but concedes even more (16 goals). In away matches, Bali United has had mixed success, managing only one win on the road. Matches involving Bali United are often high-scoring, with 8 of their last 10 away games featuring three or more goals.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Bhayangkara (4-3-3): Awan Setho; Putu Gede, Anderson Salles, Aryanto, Ruben Sanadi; Muhammad Hargianto, Matías Mier, Radja Nainggolan; Dendy Sulistyawan, Junior Brandão, Wahyu Subo Seto.
  • Bali United (4-3-3): Adilson Maringá; Novri Setiawan, Leonard Tupamahu, Willian Pacheco, Ricky Fajrin; Brwa Nouri, Eber Bessa, Fadil Sausu; Privat Mbarga, Ilija Spasojević, Irfan Jaya.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the head-to-head statistics, current form makes Bhayangkara the favorite for this match. Their solid defense and good home record should be key factors against an unstable Bali United with its defensive frailties.

  • Main Prediction: Bhayangkara to Win. The hosts are in good form and will try to exploit the opponent's defensive weaknesses to take an important three points and continue their climb up the table.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. In the last seven head-to-head meetings, the teams have consistently exchanged goals. Given Bali United's goal-scoring ability and their defensive problems, this outcome looks very likely.

Molodechno vs Maxline: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of an intriguing match in the Belarus Pershaya Liga, where FC Molodechno-2018 hosts one of the leaders and contenders for promotion to the Premier League – Maxline Vitebsk. This is a clash between a solid mid-table team and an ambitious favorite, which promises to be a tense affair.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Gorodskoy Stadion, Molodechno Competition: Belarus Pershaya Liga

Molodechno vs Maxline: Match Preview

Maxline comes into this match as one of the league leaders, fighting desperately for promotion. The team, managed by Yuri Puntus, displays a powerful attacking style of play, being one of the most prolific in the league. Molodechno, on the other hand, is a solid mid-table side that is particularly resilient at home. In their last head-to-head meeting in July, Maxline secured a convincing 3-1 victory at home. However, in last season's match at Molodechno's ground, the hosts managed to put up a fight and drew 2-2.

Team Form and Analysis

Molodechno

The team, led by Sergey Dorokhovich, is known for its fighting spirit, especially in home matches. The 'Green-Whites' rely on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. Despite their mid-table status, Molodechno regularly takes points from favorites on their home turf. Key players to watch are the experienced captain Igor Monich and one of the team's top scorers, Vladislav Fedosov.

Maxline (Vitebsk)

Maxline is one of the most exciting and attacking teams in the Pershaya Liga. The team scores a lot but also concedes regularly, which makes their matches very entertaining. Maxline also plays boldly and effectively in away games. The leader of their attack is one of the league's top scorers, Russian forward Timur Pukhov. Yuri Puntus's team cannot afford to drop points in the promotion race, so they will be coming to Molodechno only for a win.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Molodechno (4-2-3-1): Stepanov; Kventsendorf, Kozlov, Absamadov, Ladutko; Monich, Tseslyukevich; German, Goncharik, Fedosov; Krotov.
  • Maxline (4-3-3): Shcherbachenya; Balanovich, Kostomarov, Izhakovskiy, Zhuk; Zhitnev, Alshanik, Tkachik; Pukhov, Khachaturyan, Alay.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Maxline is the favorite on paper, an easy ride in Molodechno is not expected for them. The hosts are capable of challenging any opponent on their home ground. However, the visitors' extreme motivation in the fight for promotion and their powerful attack should be the deciding factors.

  • Main Prediction: Maxline to Win. Yuri Puntus's team cannot afford to drop points, and their superiority in class and attack should make the difference.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches involving Maxline are regularly high-scoring. Given that 11 goals have been scored in the last three head-to-head encounters, there is every reason to expect another goal-fest this time.

Persik Kediri vs Persebaya Surabaya: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most intense and anticipated rivalries in Indonesian football - the 'East Java Derby' (Derbi Jatim), where Persik Kediri hosts Persebaya Surabaya at their Brawijaya Stadium. This match is always characterized by high tension and an uncompromising fight, regardless of the teams' league positions.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK) Stadium: Brawijaya Stadium, Kediri Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persik Kediri vs Persebaya Surabaya: Match Preview

Both teams approach the derby sitting in the middle of the league table and showing inconsistent results. Persik Kediri lost their last match 2-0 away to Barito Putera, which ended their four-game unbeaten streak. Persebaya also suffered a defeat in their last game, losing 1-0 to PSIS Semarang. The recent head-to-head history favors Persik: the 'White Tigers' are unbeaten in their last four meetings with Persebaya, securing three wins. Notably, in the last game at this stadium, Persik thrashed their rivals 4-0.

Team Form and Analysis

Persik Kediri

The 'White Tigers,' under coach Marcelo Rospide, traditionally perform strongly at home. The team relies on fast wing attacks and set pieces. The leader of their attack is Portuguese forward Flávio Silva, who scores regularly. Despite a recent defeat, Persik will be determined to extend their successful derby run at home with the support of their fans.

Persebaya Surabaya

The 'Green Crocodiles' (Bajul Ijo) are going through a rough patch. Paul Munster's team is winless in their last two matches, having failed to score a single goal. Persebaya will be highly motivated to break their losing streak against Persik and get revenge for last year's thrashing. In attack, all hopes are on Brazilian import Bruno Moreira, who is the team's main offensive threat.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persik Kediri (4-3-3): Diksa; Haikal, Cunha, Widodo, Yusak; Mealatana, Otto, Chand; Baihaki, Flávio Silva, Supriadi.
  • Persebaya Surabaya (4-3-3): Andhika; Arief, Radovan, Duarte, Salman; Hidayat, Song, Iqbal; Bruno Moreira, Paulo Henrique, Jardim.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A derby is always an unpredictable match, but current form and head-to-head statistics make Persik Kediri slight favorites. Their strong home performances and recent success in clashes with Persebaya should give them confidence. The visitors, however, will be fighting for their pride and will try to break their unlucky streak.

  • Main Prediction: Persik Kediri to Win or Draw (1X). Given their unbeaten run in the last four derbies and the home-field advantage, the hosts should at least avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The last two matches between these teams at the Brawijaya Stadium were very high-scoring (4-0 and 2-1). The intense nature of the derby could lead to an open game with plenty of goals.

Al Najma vs Al Hilal: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the eighth round of the Saudi Pro League, where the absolute underdog of the championship, Al Najma, hosts one of the main title contenders, Al Hilal. This is a meeting of teams from opposite ends of the league table, where any result other than a convincing victory for the visitors would be a major sensation.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK) Stadium: Al-Najma Club Stadium, Unaizah Competition: Saudi Pro League

Al Najma vs Al Hilal: Match Preview

Al Najma is having a catastrophic season, having lost all seven of their opening league matches. The team is at the bottom of the table with zero points, possessing the worst attack and worst defense in the league (5 goals scored and 16 conceded). In contrast, Al Hilal is among the league leaders, sitting in third place and yet to suffer a single defeat. The Riyadh-based team has one of the best attacks (18 goals) and the most solid defense in the league (6 goals conceded) alongside other leaders. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of Al Hilal, who have won 8 of the previous 12 matches, with Al Najma's last victory dating back to the distant 2000/01 season.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Najma

The Pro League newcomer has so far failed to adapt to the realities of the top flight. The team has lost all its matches, including both at home. In the last round, Al Najma lost 2-1 to Al-Okhdood, conceding the decisive goal in the 80th minute. Against one of the strongest clubs in Asia, the hosts will find it extremely difficult to hope for even a draw.

Al Hilal

'The Boss' ('Al-Za'eem') are in excellent form and are competing for the championship title. The team boasts a star-studded squad with players like Darwin Núñez, Rúben Neves, Sergej Milinković-Savić, and Kalidou Koulibaly. Al Hilal will aim not just to win, but to do so by a large margin to improve their goal difference in the title race.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Najma (4-4-2): Braga; Al-Kunaydiri, El Yamiq, Caetano, Al-Hawsawi; Boutobba, Flores, Prekodravac, Jasim; Quioto, Lázaro.
  • Al Hilal (4-2-3-1): Al-Wated; Abdulhamid, Koulibaly, Al-Bulaihi, Hernández; Neves, Milinković-Savić; Malcom, Leonardo, Al-Dawsari; Núñez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Al Hilal is the absolute and undisputed favorite for this clash. The difference in class, current form, and player quality between the teams is colossal. The only question is by what margin the visitors will win.

  • Main Prediction: Al Hilal to Win with a (-2.5) Handicap. Given Al Najma's appalling form and Al Hilal's attacking power, a landslide victory for the visitors looks like the most probable outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Al Hilal's Individual Total Over 3 Goals. The visitors have one of the best attacks in the league and will be looking to score as many as possible against the championship's underdog.

Werder Bremen vs Wolfsburg: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the German Bundesliga, where Werder Bremen hosts VfL Wolfsburg at their Weserstadion. This is a meeting of two teams in search of consistency and aiming to improve their league standings.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 19:30 UTC (22:30 MSK) Stadium: Weserstadion, Bremen Competition: Bundesliga

Werder Bremen vs Wolfsburg: Match Preview

Wolfsburg comes into this match having broken their eight-game winless streak with a victory over Mainz in the last round. However, Ralph Hasenhüttl's side remains in the lower half of the table. Werder Bremen, on the other hand, has shown decent results, being unbeaten in their last four league matches, including two wins. The head-to-head history shows a balanced record: in 53 matches, Werder has won 21, and Wolfsburg has won 20. Notably, Wolfsburg is unbeaten against Werder in their last five encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Werder Bremen

Ole Werner's team has gained good momentum, especially in attack, where Marvin Ducksch has been shining, having scored in three of the last four games. The 'River Islanders' have won their last two home matches, which should boost their confidence. However, Werder has significant personnel problems, especially in defense: Niklas Stark, Miloš Veljković, and Amos Pieper will miss the match due to injury, and the participation of Marco Friedl is in doubt.

Wolfsburg

The long-awaited victory over Mainz should have lifted immense psychological pressure off the 'Wolves.' The team has a quality squad but has struggled to realize its potential for a long time. The leader of their attack is Danish forward Jonas Wind, who will be looking to end his goal drought. Wolfsburg will aim to build on their success and extend their unbeaten run against Werder.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Werder Bremen (3-5-2): Zetterer; Jung, Gross, Buchanan; Weiser, Bittencourt, Stage, Schmid, Agu; Njinmah, Ducksch.
  • Wolfsburg (4-2-3-1): Casteels; Baku, Lacroix, Zesiger, Mæhle; Svanberg, Vranckx; Černý, Majer, Paredes; Wind.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Werder is higher in the table and playing at home, Wolfsburg could be on an emotional high after their long-awaited victory. Given Werder's defensive personnel issues and the Wolves' successful head-to-head record, the match promises to be unpredictable.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. Werder has scored in 11 of their last 12 matches, and Wolfsburg, after scoring three goals in the last round, should have gained confidence in attack. The hosts' defensive personnel problems also favor this outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches between these teams are often high-scoring. The last five head-to-head meetings at the Weserstadion have all seen more than 2.5 goals.

Pisa vs Cremonese: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the opening match of the 13th round of Italy's Serie B, where Pisa hosts one of the main contenders for promotion, Cremonese, at their Arena Garibaldi. This is an intriguing clash between two ambitious teams that promises to be a tense affair.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Arena Garibaldi, Pisa Competition: Serie B

Pisa vs Cremonese: Match Preview

Cremonese comes into this match in excellent form, being unbeaten in their last eight league games, during which they have secured five wins. This has allowed the 'Tigers' to solidify their position in the automatic promotion zone, sitting in second place in the table. Pisa, on the other hand, is a solid mid-table team that is particularly resilient at home. In the last round, the 'Leaning Towers' drew 1-1 with Modena, extending their unbeaten streak to three matches. The head-to-head history favors Cremonese, who have won three of the last four encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Pisa

Filippo Inzaghi's side relies on an organized defense, having conceded only 10 goals in 12 matches, which is one of the best records in the league. However, Pisa's attack is not particularly prolific. At home, the 'Black and Blues' have lost only once in their last six matches. The leader of their attack is striker Nicholas Bonazzoli, who will try to cause problems for one of the league's best defenses.

Cremonese

Giovanni Stroppa's team plays the most solid football in Serie B, having conceded only 7 goals in 12 rounds. The 'Grey-Reds' are unbeaten in their last four away matches. Despite not being the highest-scoring team, Cremonese effectively converts their chances, which allows them to be at the top of the table. Veteran Franco Vázquez plays a key role in the team, and Massimo Coda is their top scorer.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Pisa (4-2-3-1): Lamanis; Barbieri, Carboni, Canestrelli, Bereszyński; Marin, Esteves; D'Alessandro, Valoti, Arena; Bonazzoli.
  • Cremonese (3-5-2): Jungdal; Antov, Ravanelli, Bianchetti; Sernicola, Abrego, Castagnetti, Collocolo, Quagliata; Vázquez, Coda.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Pisa is playing at home, Cremonese appears to be the favorite for this match. Their impressive unbeaten streak and the best defense in the league make their chances of success higher. Pisa will try to impose a tough fight, but breaking down the visitors' defense will be extremely difficult.

  • Main Prediction: Cremonese to Win or Draw (X2). The visitors are in excellent form and will aim to at least avoid defeat to maintain their position in the leading group.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a match between two teams with the best defensive records in Serie B. A six-pointer match is likely to be cautious and not very high-scoring.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 13th round of the French Ligue 1, where the capital's Paris FC hosts Stade Rennais at their Stade Charléty. This is a meeting of two teams from different parts of the league table with different objectives.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Stade Charléty, Paris Competition: Ligue 1

Paris FC vs Rennes: Match Preview

Paris FC, a newcomer to Ligue 1, comes into this match in high spirits, having secured two consecutive victories, including a sensational 2-0 away win against Lens. These results have allowed the team to climb to 13th place and create some distance from the relegation zone. Rennes, on the other hand, is one of the league leaders, sitting in second place and unbeaten in their last six matches across all competitions. The Bretons have been prolific, scoring 12 goals in their last five games. The head-to-head history between these teams consists of only one official match, which took place last season in the Coupe de France and ended in a 3-1 victory for Rennes.

Team Form and Analysis

Paris FC

Stéphane Gilli's side relies on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. Two consecutive clean sheets should have boosted the confidence of the Parisian defense. However, the team's attack is not particularly prolific. The leader of their attack is the young forward Dicko, who has already scored several important goals this season.

Rennes

The 'Red and Blacks,' under Julien Stéphan, play an exciting and attacking brand of football. The team boasts one of the strongest squads in Ligue 1, featuring standout players like Arnaud Kalimuendo, Benjamin Bourigeaud, and Amine Gouiri. Rennes is performing successfully both domestically and in the Europa League. However, the Bretons have significant personnel problems, with key players Fabian Rieder and Ludovic Blas set to miss the match due to injury.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Paris FC (4-2-3-1): Filipović; Dabila, D'Avray, Maminjina, Gaudin; Mandouki, Camara; Ghezoui, Kebbal, Lopes; Dicko.
  • Rennes (4-4-2): Mandanda; Assignon, Theate, Belocian, Truffert; Bourigeaud, Le Fée, Santamaria, Terrier; Kalimuendo, Gouiri.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Paris FC has gained momentum and is playing at home, Rennes is the clear favorite for this match. The difference in class, experience, and current form make the visitors' chances of winning significantly higher. Paris FC will try to put up a fight with a tight defense, but containing Rennes's powerful attack will be extremely difficult.

  • Main Prediction: Rennes to Win. The visitors are competing for the top spots and cannot afford to drop points against a league newcomer, despite their recent successes.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Rennes is one of the most prolific teams in the league. Given that 6 of Rennes's last 8 away matches have seen three or more goals, there is every reason to expect a high-scoring game.

Elche vs Real Sociedad: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 13th round of the Spanish La Liga, where Elche hosts one of the league leaders, Real Sociedad, at their Estadio Manuel Martínez Valero. This is a meeting of teams from opposite ends of the table, where the visitors need a victory to continue their fight for the top spots.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Estadio Manuel Martínez Valero, Elche Competition: La Liga

Elche vs Real Sociedad: Match Preview

Real Sociedad comes into this match in excellent form, being unbeaten in their last eight La Liga games. Imanol Alguacil's side sits comfortably in third place in the table, behind only Real Madrid and Barcelona. Elche, on the other hand, is one of the main relegation candidates, sitting in last place with only one win to their name. The 'Green-striped ones' are winless in their last six matches. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of Real Sociedad, who have won all of the last six meetings, with Elche failing to score in five of them.

Team Form and Analysis

Elche

The team's main problems lie in poor finishing and frequent defensive errors. Estoril vs Arouca: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the Portuguese Primeira Liga, where Estoril hosts Arouca at their Estádio António Coimbra da Mota. This is a crucial confrontation between two direct competitors in the relegation battle, where every point is of immense importance.

Kick-off: November 7, 2025, 20:15 UTC (23:15 MSK) Stadium: Estádio António Coimbra da Mota, Estoril Competition: Primeira Liga

Estoril vs Arouca: Match Preview

Both teams come into this head-to-head meeting from the relegation zone. Estoril is in 17th place with only 5 points from 10 matches. Arouca is one spot above, in 16th, with 6 points. Estoril is in a deep crisis, having suffered five consecutive league defeats. Arouca, in contrast, secured their first win of the season in the last round by beating Moreirense, which should have boosted their confidence. The head-to-head history favors Estoril, who are unbeaten against Arouca in the last six meetings (5 wins, 1 draw).

Team Form and Analysis

Estoril

The 'Canaries' are going through a very difficult period. The team has the worst defense in the league, having conceded 22 goals in 10 matches. Five consecutive losses are putting immense pressure on the team and the coach. The only bright spot is their performance at home, where Estoril claimed their only victory of the season. In the squad, Brazilian forward Alexandre Pato stands out as the main hope in attack.

Arouca

The long-awaited first victory should have given wings to Daniel Sousa's team. Arouca also has serious defensive problems, having conceded 21 goals. However, their attack has been more productive than Estoril's. Spanish forward Cristo González, who has already scored 6 league goals, is a key player. The visitors will be eager to build on their success and defeat a historically difficult opponent for the first time in a while.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Estoril (3-4-3): Carné; Vital, Basso, Álvaro; Gomes, Holsgrove, Zanocelo, Araújo; Guitane, Marqués, Pato.
  • Arouca (4-2-3-1): de Arruabarrena; Weiga, Galović, Moniz, Esquerdo; Simão, Sylla; Jason, González, Maranhão; Mujica.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two out-of-form underdogs is extremely difficult to predict. Estoril has the advantage of their home ground and a successful head-to-head history. Arouca, however, is on an emotional high after their first win.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. Both teams have the worst defensive records in the league, conceding an average of more than two goals per game. At the same time, both have players in attack capable of deciding moments. In a six-pointer, the teams are unlikely to sit back in defense.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches involving these teams this season have often been high-scoring due to their defensive issues. Given the importance of the match, an open game with plenty of goals can be expected.
